# clio compliance inventory

Read the stored record families and known copies: one row per family with its source, subject link or named gap, custody, and retention action; open rows stay open and named, declared caller copies are recorded and never touched, and nothing is written

## Usage

```
clio compliance inventory [--output json|text]
```

## Description

reads the stored record families and their subject links against the live store and reports one row per family with its source, link or named gap, custody, and retention action; a row whose link or source is missing stays open and is named, the complete flag stays false while anything is open or unclassified, and every --copy PATH declares a caller-held copy that is recorded and never touched

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--copy PATH` | text |  | Declares one caller-held copy; `compliance_cli` passes every declared path to `clio_compliance::scope_inventory`, whose copy rows record it and never touch it (the path is read with `std::fs::metadata` only). |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Report the stored families and known copies.
```
clio compliance inventory
```

Emit the serialized scope inventory as JSON.
```
clio compliance inventory -o json
```

Record one caller-held copy beside the store's rows.
```
clio compliance inventory --copy ./exports/a.jsonl
```
